game_concept: A survival strategy set in Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows, reef shallows: the harbor master must handle smugglers while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Truth Table Tiles: Fill in truth-table tiles for and/or/not to light the correct path.
theme: Coastal Port – Coral Reef Shallows: reef shallows
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Termination: Use Step to inspect the loop condition. reduce each positive input to zero by subtracting 1 until the condition fails; every procedure must terminate. Match all 3 streams; preserve their order. Dataset 4, operand 15.
controls: Edit both node programs. IN reads the upstream queue; OUT sends to the next node. Step advances one cycle; Run checks every stream.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Truth Table Tiles' (Week 3 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Coral Reef Shallows'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the ship's hull from smugglers in Coral Reef Shallows: keep the table_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: table_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
source_game_title: Truth Table Tiles – Coral Reef Shallows Defense
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
